title: Fairness in machine learning: Against false positive rate equality as a measure of fairness
reasoning: The paper is a philosophical and ethical analysis of fairness metrics in machine learning. Its central purpose is to provide an 'ethical framework' for evaluating fairness measures like calibration and false positive rate equality, arguing that the latter is an 'incoherent standard for evaluating the fairness of algorithms.' This deep engagement with the normative properties of fairness metrics constitutes the core of the paper, not a brief supplementary section.
